ownerAuthority.exactUserText: 我没搞懂，为什么你总需要授权？我想改一下这个设定，你可以全权负责
ownerAuthority.interpretation: The owner explicitly requests that the project replace repeated per-attempt authorization prompts with standing autonomous authority for in-scope project work.

purpose: Build and continuously improve a complete real AI-native film studio project using the published film-engine fork and the BlenderFilmStudio research/evidence repository.
standingAuthorizedActions: Read and inspect all project, source, build, dependency, evidence and toolchain files on the admitted host.
Create and edit in-scope source, tests, specifications, documentation, scripts, assets and configuration in BlenderFilmStudio and local film-engine workspaces.
Create fresh bounded work/evidence roots; run local builds, tests, Blender processes, zero-render and render validations, benchmarks and audits under versioned protocols.
Use caffeinate and other non-destructive host controls needed to keep approved local work running.
Perform necessary read-only network checks and download public source/dependencies when a versioned protocol records identity, size and provenance.
Create ordinary Git commits and perform non-force fast-forward pushes to existing lovejzzz/BlenderFilmStudio and lovejzzz/film-engine branches after relevant validation passes.
Create and update ordinary project branches and pull requests in the two existing repositories when this advances the project and does not publish a binary release.
Publish research evidence, documentation and CI results to the existing public research repository.
Preregister and execute later Phase B gates without asking for a new exact authorization sentence when the action remains within this charter.
Diagnose failures, retain immutable failed attempts, create versioned corrections, rerun only in fresh roots and continue until the bounded gate closes PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED.
actionsStillRequiringSpecificConfirmatio: Any purchase, paid service, new billable cloud resource, paid LFS transfer or acceptance of new storage/bandwidth charges.
Deleting, recreating, transferring, renaming or changing visibility of a repository; deleting material user data; destructive cleanup outside an exact generated root.
Force-pushing, rewriting published history, deleting refs/tags, or bypassing branch protections.
Creating a public binary release, distributing a DMG, signing, notarizing, changing Gatekeeper behavior or making production-readiness claims.
Changing credentials, account, organization, billing, security or access-control settings.
Sending messages or making commitments to third parties, accepting legal terms, or asserting legal/compliance sufficiency on the owner's behalf.
Materially expanding beyond BlenderFilmStudio/film-engine or exceeding a preregistered resource ceiling.

operatingRules.default: Proceed autonomously with safe, in-scope, reversible project work and proportionate verification; do not ask for repeated authorization.
operatingRules.versioning: Do not edit historical frozen contracts or evidence in place. Supersede them with a versioned amendment and cross-bind retained outcomes.
operatingRules.evidence: Record exact inputs, commands, identities, resource use, outputs, failures and hashes for scientific gates.
operatingRules.git: Use normal fast-forward history for project publication; never use force or delete published refs without specific confirmation.
operatingRules.resources: Preserve at least 100 GiB free disk plus projected writes before native builds/renders unless a later explicit owner decision changes this ceiling.
operatingRules.failure: Fail closed at frozen semantic/safety/resource gates, retain the result, then prepare the smallest versioned correction without asking again when still in scope.
operatingRules.stop: Stop and request specific confirmation only for an action listed in actionsStillRequiringSpecificConfirmation or when target/scope cannot be resolved safely.

nonOverrideableBoundaries: OpenAI platform, system, tool and safety policies remain in force and cannot be changed by this repository charter.
Tool-level approvals or external service permissions may still be technically required.
The charter is not authority for destructive, costly, legal, credential, account, signing, notarization or public binary distribution actions listed above.
revocation: The owner may narrow, pause or revoke this standing authority at any time in a later message.
claimCeiling: Standing operational authority only. It does not prove product quality, production readiness, distribution readiness, legal sufficiency or autonomous filmmaking.
